summary: Implemented the endpoint resolution v2 builtin parameter assignment. Changes: botocore/args.py adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults(region_name, endpoint_url, client_config), returning AWS::Region, AWS::UseFIPS, AWS::UseDualStack, SDK::Endpoint, AWS::S3::Accelerate, AWS::S3::ForcePathStyle, AWS::S3::UseArnRegion, and AWS::S3Control::UseArnRegion. botocore/client.py moves ClientArgsCreator construction into _create_client_args_creator() and adds ClientCreator._get_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults() as glue. tests/unit/test_args.py gains four tests. Left out of scope: AWS::STS::UseGlobalEndpoint and the S3 multi-region access point builtin. Verification: test_args.py and test_client.py pass (294). Full unit suite has 11 failures in test_awsrequest.py, test_session.py, and test_session_legacy.py; the same 11 fail on a clean HEAD export, so they predate this change. Nothing committed; changes are unstaged in the working tree.
